description: One change to many mentions at once: status ("ignored", "done", "open"), assigneeId (a member, null to unassign), addLabels and removeLabels (removals first, so moving a label is one call). Name the mentions by ids (up to 100, from search_mentions; all of it lands or none of it does, unknown ids come back in notFound) OR by filter, the search_mentions filters as an object, to act on everything they select ("mark all open mentions as done": filter {status: "open"}, update {status: "done"}): up to 1,000 a call, newest first, and while nextCursor comes back call again with the same filter and that cursor. A mention still being classified keeps its status (it is listed in pending) but takes the labels and assignee. Use it to triage a page of results, clear an inbox, or label mentions that existed before an automation.

cursor.description: With filter only: nextCursor from the previous call, to carry on where it stopped.

filter.description: Instead of ids: every mention GET /v1/mentions would list with these filters, up to 1000 a call, newest first. Repeat with the same filter and nextCursor until it is null.

alertId.description: Apply an alert rule's filter (an id from GET /v1/alerts) on top of the other filters: the same mentions the rule would send, for a feed-shaped export or a preview. Unknown ids are a 404.

anyOf.description: OR across groups of conditions, as URL-encoded JSON: a mention passes when one group holds, on top of every other filter. Each group holds view-filter conditions, no nesting. See [anyOf](/conventions#or-across-groups-anyof).

assigneeId.description: Only mentions assigned to this workspace member (user id).

automated.description: true: only mentions that read as machine-made (a bot account, a scheduled or templated post, AI-written text); false: only the rest, mentions judged before this existed included. Omitted: everything.

countries.description: Only posts whose author is in any of these countries (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2: us, in, de), as the classifier read the author's profile and the post. A post whose country is unknown never passes.

emotions.description: Only mentions showing any of these emotions toward the keyword (joy, trust, anticipation, surprise, confusion, frustration, anger, fear, sadness, neutral). A mention whose emotion was not judged never passes.

items.description: An emotion toward the keyword (see classification.emotion).

excludeAuthors.description: Deprecated: use notAuthors, the same filter. Both may be sent; every author named in either is hidden.

from.description: Start, inclusive: a day (YYYY-MM-DD, from its first moment in `timezone`) or an instant (ISO 8601 with its offset, or epoch ms).

groupIds.description: Only matches of keywords in any of these groups (grp_...). Repeatable, or comma-separated.

includeDuplicates.description: true: list cross-posts (a mention whose duplicateOf is set) as mentions of their own. By default each is listed only in its original's duplicates.

includeHidden.description: true: include mentions their keyword's display lists hide (a language or country it does not show), hidden by default.

includeMuted.description: true: include mentions by people you muted, hidden by default: muted for the workspace, or for the mention's own keyword group.

intent.description: Deprecated: use intents. Only mentions carrying this intent or topic tag, combined with intents as either (buy_intent, question, complaint, praise, comparison, churn_intent, bug_report, pricing, hiring, event, promotional, testimonial, industry_insight, launch, feedback).

intents.description: Only mentions carrying any of these intent or topic tags.

isReply.description: true: only replies and comments (posts answering another post); false: only top-level posts. Omitted: both.

keywordId.description: Deprecated: use keywordIds. Only matches of this keyword; combines with keywordIds as either.

keywordIds.description: Only matches of any of these keywords.

keywordKinds.description: Only matches of keywords of any of these kinds: brand, competitor, topic. Repeatable, or comma-separated.

kind.description: Only posts (post), only comments (comment) or only GitHub repository events (repository). Omitted: all.

labels.description: Only mentions carrying any of these labels (exact, case-sensitive). Repeatable, or comma-separated.

languages.description: Only posts in any of these languages (ISO 639-1: en, es, de). A post whose language is unknown never passes.

linkHosts.description: Only posts linking to any of these hosts, the host itself or a subdomain of it (octolens.com also matches blog.octolens.com). Repeatable, or comma-separated.

maxFollowers.description: Only authors with at most this many followers. Unknown reach never passes.

minBookmarks.description: Only posts with at least this many bookmarks (saves), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.

minConfidence.description: Only mentions whose classifier confidence is at least this, 0 to 1. Mentions without a confidence are excluded.

minFollowers.description: Only authors with at least this many followers. Unknown reach never passes.

minLikes.description: Only posts with at least this many likes (upvotes, reactions), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.

minQuotes.description: Only posts with at least this many quotes, as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.

minRelevance.description: Only mentions scored at least this; unclassified ones are excluded.

minReplies.description: Only posts with at least this many replies (comments), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.

minReposts.description: Only posts with at least this many reposts (shares, retweets), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.

minViews.description: Only posts with at least this many views (plays), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.

notAuthors.description: Hide these authors: display names, handles or profile URLs. Repeatable, or one comma-separated value.

notCountries.description: Never posts whose author is in these countries: notCountries=in. A post whose country is unknown still passes.

notEmotions.description: Never these emotions. A mention whose emotion was not judged still passes.

items.description: An emotion toward the keyword (see classification.emotion).

notGroupIds.description: Never matches of keywords in these groups.

notIntents.description: Never mentions carrying these intent or topic tags.

notKeywordKinds.description: Never matches of keywords of these kinds. Repeatable, or comma-separated.

notLabels.description: Never mentions carrying any of these labels. Repeatable, or comma-separated.

notLanguages.description: Never posts in these languages. A post whose language is unknown still passes.

notLinkHosts.description: Never posts linking to these hosts, the host itself or a subdomain of it.

items.description: Platform: bluesky, hackernews, github, stackoverflow, devto, reddit, x, youtube, news, linkedin, tiktok, instagram, facebook, appstore (App Store reviews), googleplay (Google Play reviews), trustpilot (Trustpilot reviews), googlemaps (Google reviews of a place), rss (RSS and Atom feeds a keyword reads).

notRatings.description: Never reviews with these star ratings (1 to 5): notRatings=5 hides the five star reviews. Posts that are not reviews still pass.

notSentiments.description: Never these sentiments. A mention the classifier has not scored yet still passes.

notSubreddits.description: Never Reddit posts from these subreddits; posts from other platforms still pass.

notTags.description: Never authors tagged with any of these, in the workspace's tags or those of the mention's own keyword group.

organization.description: true: only posts by companies, brands and organizations (a LinkedIn company page, a GitHub organization, a business account); false: only posts by people, mentions judged before this existed included. Omitted: everything.

personId.description: Only this person (an id from /v1/people), merged accounts included. Implies includeMuted.

platform.description: Deprecated: use platforms. Only posts from this platform; combines with platforms as either.

platforms.description: Only posts from any of these platforms.

items.description: Platform: bluesky, hackernews, github, stackoverflow, devto, reddit, x, youtube, news, linkedin, tiktok, instagram, facebook, appstore (App Store reviews), googleplay (Google Play reviews), trustpilot (Trustpilot reviews), googlemaps (Google reviews of a place), rss (RSS and Atom feeds a keyword reads).

q.description: Substring search in the post text or the author's name.

range.description: A preset window ending now: 7d is today and the six days before, in `timezone`, as in the analytics reports. Ignored when from or to is given. Omit range, from and to for no window.

ratings.description: Only app store reviews with any of these star ratings (1 to 5): ratings=1,2 is the unhappy ones. Every other post fails it.

relevant.description: true: only mentions the classifier scored relevant; false: only the rest (unclassified included).

sentiment.description: Deprecated: use sentiments. Only this sentiment; combines with sentiments as either.

since.description: Deprecated: use from. Only posts published at or after this instant (ISO 8601, or epoch ms).

snoozed.description: true: only mentions currently snoozed. Otherwise snoozed mentions stay out until they wake.

status.description: Only mentions in this status. Omit for every status.

subreddits.description: Only Reddit posts from any of these subreddits: subreddits=SaaS,startups (names without the r/, any case). Every other post fails it. Repeatable, or comma-separated.

tags.description: Only authors tagged with any of these (exact, case-sensitive), in the workspace's tags or those of the mention's own keyword group. Repeatable, or comma-separated.

timezone.description: IANA zone that days in range, from and to are cut in (Europe/Madrid). Default UTC.

to.description: End, inclusive: a day (YYYY-MM-DD, to its last moment in `timezone`) or an instant (ISO 8601 with its offset, or epoch ms).

until.description: Deprecated: use to. Only posts published at or before this instant (ISO 8601, or epoch ms).

viewId.description: Apply a saved view's filter (an id from GET /v1/views) on top of the other filters, every condition ANDed: exactly what the view selects. Unknown ids are a 404.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. A unique value (a UUID) for this call: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters, no spaces. Calling again with the same key and the same input within 24 hours returns the first result instead of doing it twice.

ids.description: Mention ids (mm_...), 1 to 100: a page of GET /v1/mentions. Send ids or filter, never both.

update.description: Every field is optional, at least one is required; omitted fields are untouched.

addLabels.description: Labels to add; a mention keeps at most 20, and labels past that are not added.

assigneeId.description: A workspace member (user id), or null to unassign.

removeLabels.description: Labels to remove; a label a mention does not carry is ignored.

status.description: ignored or done to handle them; open to put them back.

title: Update mentions
